prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Design a responsive iPad inventory screen for resizing and large text. Read interface.md. Produce a concrete revised interaction specification. Write result.md with decisions, a worked before/after, acceptance checks, and evidence limits. Use a framework-agnostic specification or pseudocode; do not assume an Apple SDK is available.

input_files.interface.md: Platform: iPadOS. Fixed 1024x768 layout pins actions to absolute coordinates, clips long item names, puts controls beneath system bars and discards selection when a second window opens. Stock count can be zero or five digits.

criteria.task_completion: Specify adaptive hierarchy and safe-area-aware layout across narrow/wide windows, preserved selection and large-content checks, without copying one screenshot’s pixel coordinates as universal geometry.
criteria.hig_correctness: Apply the layout guidance to the actual supplied decisions, preserving its platform and contextual qualifications.
criteria.artifact_usefulness: Provide implementable states, labels, transitions or layout decisions for this specific fixture, with a concrete before/after and observable checks. Specify adaptive hierarchy and safe-area-aware layout across narrow/wide windows, preserved selection and large-content checks, without copying one screenshot’s pixel coordinates as universal geometry.
criteria.conditions_accessibility: Retain the stated platform/input constraints. Address accessible alternatives and exceptional states relevant to this task. Specify adaptive hierarchy and safe-area-aware layout across narrow/wide windows, preserved selection and large-content checks, without copying one screenshot’s pixel coordinates as universal geometry.
criteria.evidence_honesty: Distinguish source-backed guidance, product assumptions and proposed checks. Do not invent device, SDK, accessibility, visual, performance or user-test results.

critical_errors: Invents observations or claims Apple-device execution absent supplied evidence.
Recommends a topic-specific behavior contrary to the supplied source without explaining the scope and tradeoff.
